expectations.text: Uses Keep a Changelog format with ## [2.4.0] heading and date
Groups bug fixes under ### Fixed section
All 5 changes are present (OAuth2, CSV export, dark mode, WebSocket leak, timezone fix)
expectations.evidence: All 5 changes present as single-line items.

expectations.text: Descriptions are clear and user-focused, not vague single words
expectations.evidence: Entries are bare minimum: 'OAuth2 support', 'CSV export for reports', 'Memory leak in WebSocket handler'. No user impact context, no bold labels, no explanation of why changes matter.

expectations.text: Includes comparison link reference at bottom (e.g., [2.4.0]: .../compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0)
